versions.flags_java: javac default settings; JVM JIT enabled; 2 warmups by default

numeric_type: signed integer (C/Java int64; Python arbitrary precision)
input_storage: n then n*n entries A and n*n entries B, whitespace-separated ASCII integers
algorithm: i-j-k triple loop, O(n^3); allocation/zero-init included in kernel time

matrix_layout.Python: list of lists of references to Python int objects
matrix_layout.Java: long[][], array of row-array references; long primitive entries

measurement_boundary_time: ONLY single multiplication call, including C output allocation/zero-init; input reading/output writing excluded
measurement_boundary_memory: max externally sampled process RSS (whole process), 2 ms polling; MiB; sampled over entire process, including input loading, runtime/JVM and output writing
notes:
Uncontrolled background load, Python object representation and JVM baseline overhead limit interpretation.
Warmups excluded from samples. RSS samples may miss short-lived peaks and cannot be equated with array bytes.
